observations: transfer.c read_sf_internal takes a comma-scanning slow path when compile_options.warn_std == 0; its comma checks do not test sf_read_comma.
read.c read_a disables sf_read_comma for character reads. transfer.c external read_sf checks this flag before treating a comma as a separator.
format.c parses and caches FORMAT descriptions and contains a synthetic colon at reversion. Its parser copies the source format when constructing a new parsed description.
Runtime parser tokens show rounding, decimal, DT, EN/ES and other later descriptors. Untested features in the catalogue are labeled source-only.
